intro: A few recent pieces, spanning writing and photography.

items.title: My Community My University: How Community-Based Research Stopped a Coal Power Plant in Myanmar
items.description: Read more about Mi Tri, an activist and community-based researcher from Mon State, Myanmar, who, together with her community, resisted a coal-fired power plant in her community. This was part of a three part series on community based research tools.

items.title: Collaboration between The Bowl Spot and Chow Chow Chiang Mai
items.description: I was hired to photograph the making of a new recipe and menu. [photos to be uploaded soon]

items.title: Drawing the River Under Surveillance: How Communities in Laos Protect Their Rights and Natural Resources
items.description: Interviewed Bounmy, a Lao lawyer and community rights defenders, on how he works directly with communities and the tools he uses. This was part of a three part series on community based research tools.

items.title: Bringing Out Community Knowledge: LEAD Lessons from the Mekong
items.description: Blog post and briefer on community-led research methods in the Mekong region, compiled from multi-country training sessions.
